description:
The stable frame and thoughtful geometry make this an ideal balance bike for 3-year-old riders who are ready for more speed and control. Traction Tread™ tires and a sturdy steel frame help kids feel secure on their balance bike as their skills progress. The included classic kids bike bell is sure to make this bike an instant favorite.
This toddler balance bike is ready for neighborhood rides, park paths, and backyard adventures. The puncture-proof tires and responsive handling make the Glide and Go Balance Bike a worry-free ride-on toy option wherever their adventure takes them.
The adjustable seat allows the Glide and Go to adapt as your child grows taller and more confident. The integrated non-slip grip tape acts as a footrest for coasting like a pro. Every detail of this glide bike for kids is built to support comfort, control, and joyful movement.
